mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 PM, we are looking at 63 degrees with foggy conditions around the Verona Public Library, and the moon is in its first quarter phase. It will be a rainy night with an overnight low of 60 degrees.

The City of Verona has announced that chip sealing road maintenance will begin September 23 on roads including Cross Country Road, East Verona Avenue, and Liberty Business Park, so please drive carefully. Additionally, the Plan Commission will meet October 5 to review several development projects and site plans.

It is a big weekend in Verona! Tomorrow, September 20, you can head to the Sugar River Fire and Smoke BBQ Festival, join the Bike the Barns fundraiser at Badger Prairie County Park, or enjoy live music at Bailey's Run and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, you can enjoy Yoga at Insight Wellness on Sunday or trivia nights early next week.

In our weekly police report, on September 10, officers responded to a burglary in progress in the 600 block of Hunters Cove Way where a suspect was taken into custody after a shot was fired during the incident.
Today's Flavor of the Day was the wonderful Caramel Cashew. Since the shop is now closed for the night, please note that we will be serving Butter Pecan tomorrow when we open at 10:00 AM.
